newsitem.title: USA: NYS tax amnesty collects $200 mln so far--official.
newsitem.headline: NYS tax amnesty collects $200 mln so far--official.

text.p: New York State Budget Director Patricia Woodworth Thursday released updated figures for the state's Tax Amnesty program showing preliminary gross amnesty collections at $200 million through February 4.
Woodworth cautioned in a press release that the final net financial plan benefit will remain unknown until all collections are accounted for.

While preliminary gross amnesty collections reported to the State Department of Taxation and Finance tallied $200 million through February 4, gross amnesty collections must total roughly $450 million if the state is to reach its goal of realizing a $110 million net financial plan benefit, the release said.

Though the program ended January 31, the tax department expects to continue processing and depositing amnesty returns for the next two to three weeks, and to continue billing and receiving payments for the next several months, the release said.
